messages.content: What is the equivalent of $20 in British Pounds?

message.content:
I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data right now, but as a rough guide you can use the most recent average rate I’ve seen: 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that figure:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So about **£15½** would be the equivalent of $20 at that rate. Keep in mind that actual rates vary throughout the day and depend on the source (bank, credit card, online converter, etc.), so you may see a slightly different amount when you check a live currency converter or your bank’s quote.
